top_signals.title: Chinese Government to Speed Bond Sales to Stimulate Growth
top_signals.summary: China’s central and local governments will probably raise at least a net 2.2 trillion yuan ($330 billion) in bond sales in the final two months of the year, the second-highest amount on record for the period, as the authorities step up efforts to support growth.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
